records.jp: はー……ここだと勉強しなくていいから<CR>ほんと楽だよー。勉強なんてごめんだー！
records.en_original: Ahh... How great is it that we don't have to study here? Studying is the worrrrst!
records.en: Aah... It is so easy here because we do not have to study.<CR>No more studying for me!

records.jp: 勇希、勉強苦手っていうけど、どのくらい苦手？<CR>例えば……この問題解ける？
records.en_original: You've said that you're no good in school, but how bad are you? Like...can you solve this problem?
records.en: You say you are bad at studying, Yuki, but how bad are you?<CR>For example... can you solve this problem?

records.jp: んー……？　んん……？
records.en_original: Mm? Hmmmm...
records.en: Mm? Hmmmm...

records.jp: あはは、全然わかんない！
records.en_original: Ahaha, I have no idea!
records.en: Ahaha, I have no idea!

records.jp: え、嘘……。これ、中学生レベルの問題だよ。<CR>さすがにそれはまずくない……？
records.en_original: Seriously? This is a problem for, like, middle schoolers. That seems...not great.
records.en: No way... This is a middle-school-level problem.<CR>Is that not seriously bad...?

records.jp: そ、そんなにヤバい……？
records.en_original: I-is it really that bad...?
records.en: I-is it really that bad...?

records.jp: ちょっとは勉強した方が良いと思う……。<CR>勇希のためにも
records.en_original: I think you might need to study just a little... For your own sake.
records.en: I think you might need to study just a little...<CR>For your own sake.

records.jp: 私も付き合うし！
records.en_original: Don't worry, I'll help you!
records.en: I will study with you too!

records.jp: う……そこまで言うなら……
records.en_original: Ugh... If you say so...
records.en: Ugh... If you say so...

records.jp: あ、また同じミスしてる。さっき教えたでしょ？<CR>聞いてなかったの？
records.en_original: You made the same mistake again? I just taught you this, didn't I? Were you listening?
records.en: You made the same mistake again? I just taught you this, didn't<CR>I? Were you listening?

records.jp: うー、ごめん……
records.en_original: Wahhh, I'm sorry...
records.en: Wahhh, I'm sorry...

records.jp: いいですか、金城さん。この問題はですね……
records.en_original: Alright, Ms. Kinjou, I'm going to explain this one more time.
records.en: Now then, Kinjou-san. This problem works like this...

records.jp: ……ぷぷ、何その口調
records.en_original: Pft... Why are you talking like that?
records.en: Pft... Why are you talking like that?

records.jp: ……いやー、ちょっと教師風に行こうかなって
records.en_original: I was trying to sound like a real teacher...
records.en: I was trying to sound like a real teacher...

records.jp: 変なの。面白いけど
records.en_original: You're so weird. But it is kinda funny.
records.en: You're so weird. But it is kinda funny.

records.jp: 金城さん、今度はちゃんと聞いててくださいね？<CR>分からなかったらすぐ聞くように！
records.en_original: All right, Ms. Kinjou, make sure you listen, got it? Tell me if you don't understand something.
records.en: Kinjou-san, please listen properly this time, all right?<CR>Ask me immediately if you do not understand!

records.jp: はーい、愛央ちゃんせんせー！
records.en_original: Yes, Ms. Ao!
records.en: Yes, Ao-chan-sensei!

records.jp: 勇希、できた？　ちょっと見せてもらってもいい？<CR>……あれ、また同じミスしてる
records.en_original: How are you doing, Yuki? Shall I take a look? Oops, looks like you made the same mistake here.
records.en: How are you doing, Yuki? Shall I take a look? Oops, looks<CR>like you made the same mistake here.

records.jp: ありゃ？　おかしいなあ……
records.en_original: Huh? That's weird...
records.en: Huh? That's weird...

records.jp: ふふ、勇希ったらおっちょこちょいなんだから。<CR>お姉ちゃんがもう一度教えてあげるわね？
records.en_original: Hehe, you've always been a bit of an airhead. Let your big sis show you again, okay?
records.en: Hehe, Yuki, you are such a scatterbrain.<CR>Onee-chan will teach you one more time, all right?

records.jp: ……何その口調。お姉ちゃん？
records.en_original: ...Why are you talking like that? Big sis?
records.en: ...What's with that tone? 'Onee-chan'?

records.jp: ……いやー、なんか勉強教えてたら<CR>勇希が妹に見えてきて
records.en_original: Well, after teaching you for a bit, I started to feel like you were my little sister.
records.en: Well, after teaching you for a bit, I started to feel<CR>like you were my younger sister.

records.jp: あはは。何それ
records.en_original: Ahaha. You weirdo.
records.en: Ahaha. You weirdo.

records.jp: 愛央おねーちゃん！　あたし、外で遊びたいなー
records.en_original: Big Sis, I wanna play outside!
records.en: Ao-oneechan! I want to play outside!

records.jp: ダーメ。お勉強終わったらね？
records.en_original: Not right now. After you finish your studying, okay?
records.en: Not right now. After you finish your studying, okay?

records.jp: お姉ちゃんっていうか……お母さんって感じじゃない？
records.en_original: Big sister, huh? More like my mom...
records.en: Rather than an older sister... do you not sound more like a mom?

records.jp: よし、解けたー！<CR>なんかわかってきたかも。もしかしてあたしって天才？
records.en_original: I did it! I think I'm starting to get this. I might be a genius after all!
records.en: I did it! I think<CR>I'm starting to get this. I might be a genius after all!

records.jp: やるじゃん、勇希。飲み込み早いね
records.en_original: Nice work, Yuki! You're a quick learner.
records.en: Nice work, Yuki! You're a quick learner.

records.jp: ふふん。でしょでしょ。<CR>なんか解けると楽しくなってくるね
records.en_original: Hehe. I know, right? It feels pretty good when you finally solve it, huh?
records.en: Hehe. I know, right? It feels<CR>pretty good when you finally solve it, huh?

records.jp: 愛央が教えてくれてるおかげだね。<CR>あたし一人だったら絶対挫折してたもん
records.en_original: And it's all thanks to you for teaching me! I'm sure I would have just gotten frustrated and quit by myself.
records.en: And it's all thanks to you for teaching me! I'm sure<CR>I would have just gotten frustrated and quit by myself.

records.jp: 勇希がやる気になってくれたおかげだよ。<CR>私も教えてて楽しいもん
records.en_original: Don't sell yourself short. Besides, I'm having fun teaching you.
records.en: Don't sell yourself short. Besides, I'm<CR>having fun teaching you.

records.jp: よーし、次行くよ！
records.en_original: All right, on to the next one!
records.en: All right, on to the next one!

records.jp: よしこい！
records.en_original: Let's do it!
records.en: Bring it on!

records.jp: 調子に乗るのは早いよ。<CR>まだまだ基礎の基礎なんだから
records.en_original: Don't get ahead of yourself, now. This is still super basic stuff.
records.en: Don't get ahead of yourself,<CR>now. This is still super basic stuff.

records.jp: ちょっとくらい褒めてくれてもいいじゃーん
records.en_original: Oh, come on... Not even a "good job, Yuki"?
records.en: Oh, come on... Not even a "good job, Yuki"?

records.jp: んー、それじゃあ次の問題一人で解けたら、<CR>褒めてあげる
records.en_original: All right, then. If you can solve the next one all by yourself, I'll praise you all you want.
records.en: All right, then. If you can solve the next one all by yourself, I'll praise<CR>you all you want.

records.jp: お、言ったな？　絶対解いてやるー！
records.en_original: Deal! This problem doesn't stand a chance!
records.en: Deal! This problem doesn't stand a chance!

records.jp: 頑張れー
records.en_original: Good luck.
records.en: Good luck.

records.jp: ……できた！　はい！
records.en_original: ...Done! Here you go!
records.en: ...Done! Here you go!

records.jp: んー……。あ、間違えてる
records.en_original: Let's see... Ah, wrong.
records.en: Let's see... Ah, wrong.

records.jp: うそ！　あ、待って。一人で考える！
records.en_original: What?! Wait, don't tell me where. I'm gonna figure it out!
records.en: What?! Wait, don't tell me where. I'm gonna figure it out!

records.jp: （……ふふ、教え甲斐あるなあ）
records.en_original: (Haha, looks like my lessons are working.)
records.en: (...Hehe, she is worth teaching.)

records.jp: それじゃ、今日はこのくらいにしようか
records.en_original: Well, that's about enough for today.
records.en: Well, that's about enough for today.

records.jp: 疲れたああー……。一年分くらい頭使ったー
records.en_original: Aaaah, I'm exhausted! I think that's enough studying for the year.
records.en: I am exhaausted... I used about a year’s worth of brainpower.

records.jp: もう、大げさだなあ
records.en_original: Oh, quit complaining.
records.en: Oh, quit complaining.

records.jp: また、こうやって勉強しよっか
records.en_original: Let's do this again sometime.
records.en: Let's do this again sometime.

records.jp: うん。意外と楽しかったし、いいよ。<CR>あ、でも少し間を置いて欲しい……
records.en_original: Sure. It was actually more fun that I thought it'd be. But let's give it a little while...
records.en: Yeah. It was surprisingly fun, so sure.<CR>Ah, but please give me a little time before the next one...

records.jp: はいはい。じゃ、また今度ね
records.en_original: Yeah, yeah. Can't wait.
records.en: Yeah, yeah. Can't wait.

records.jp: 今日はいっぱい勉強したし、<CR>今度は思いっきり遊ぼうか
records.en_original: You studied hard today, so let's have some fun next time.
records.en: You studied hard today, so let's<CR>have some fun next time.

records.jp: さんせー！
records.en_original: Yeaaaahh!
records.en: Yeaaaahh!

records.jp: でも、たまには勉強もいいなって思った。<CR>愛央と勉強するの、楽しかったし
records.en_original: But I think studying from time to time would be good too. It was fun having you as my teacher.
records.en: But I think studying from time to time would be good<CR>too. It was fun having you as my teacher.

records.jp: ふふ、やる気になったようで何より
records.en_original: Haha, I'm glad you're feeling motivated now!
records.en: Haha, I'm glad you're feeling motivated now!

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR><CR>Fragment.
